query.original: Ancient Roman aqueduct engineering primary sources

results.title: Pont du Gard — UNESCO World Heritage documentation
results.description: The Pont du Gard, part of the Nimes aqueduct, is a three-tiered arch bridge roughly 50 meters high, built without mortar using precisely cut stone blocks weighing up to six tons.

results.title: Vitruvius, De Architectura Book VIII — on water supply
results.description: Vitruvius's first-century BCE architectural treatise devotes Book VIII to locating, testing, and channeling water sources, including specifications for lead versus terracotta piping.
